newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GLAVERBEL SETS DIVIDEND, SAYS Q1 SALES UP.
newsitem.headline: GLAVERBEL SETS DIVIDEND, SAYS Q1 SALES UP.

text.p: SA confirmed on Friday that 1996 group net profit rose to 1.77
billion Belgian francs from 621 million in 1995.
In a final statement on 1996 earnings, Glaverbel said it
would pay a gross dividend of 140 francs a share, up from 84
francs in 1995, when it cut its dividend for the first time in
Shareholders have already received a 28 franc interim
dividend, designed to make up the difference between the 1995
and 1994 payouts. The balance to be paid -- 112 francs -- is the
same as paid each year between 1991 and 1994 inclusive.
Glaverbel added that sales rose around 17 percent to 10
billion Belgian francs in the first three months of 1997,
confirming "the recovery in shipment volumes during the second
"This performance was achieved in a situation of intense
competition, which kept prices at a very low level," it said.
Glaverbel is majority owned by Japan's Asahi Glass Co Ltd
